# Selected-ID writer fixture

`native-5.2.1.blend` is an independently authored Blender 5.2.1 LTS
(build `9e2066aef7ef`) partial library, generated by
`scripts/make-extract-fixture.py` under factory startup and disabled autoexec.
It contains a `ClosureProbe` compositor with Render Layers → Blur and an
explicit Scene reference. Blender's own `bpy.data.libraries.write` retained
that Scene and its factory dependencies; the extraction tests must refuse
until the Scene reference is explicitly cleared. No external project assets
or main-file saves were used.

The fixture also exercises native nonzero unsaved handles for empty interface
panels and menu runtime data. Native reopen/append proof is implemented in
`scripts/prove-extract-native.py`; opening a library synthesizes an empty Scene
and warns `Library file, loading empty scene`, for both writers.

Regeneration changes old-address identities; tests derive indices/addresses from
the actual file. Run the generator with the exact Blender build and a fresh path.
